decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribe. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey to put powerful Goblins onto the battlefield for free, along with Goblin Warchief to reduce their casting cost, this deck can quickly establish a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Gempalm Incinerator provide additional removal and reach to close out the game. The deck aims to win the game through early aggression and efficient use of its tribal synergy.

The focus of this deck is to control the opponent's resources while ramping up mana quickly with Mox Diamond and effectively using Oath of Druids to put powerful creatures like Terravore onto the battlefield. The deck also includes disruption and removal spells like Sphere of Resistance, Naturalize, Earthquake, and Pyroclasm to deal with threats. The land base is optimized for mana acceleration and disruption with cards like Wasteland and Rishadan Port. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and efficient control strategies.

The deck aims to quickly ramp up mana production with cards like Mox Diamond and Birds of Paradise, while disrupting the opponent's resources with Armageddon and Wasteland. The key creature, Terravore, benefits from land destruction as it grows larger with each land put into the graveyard. Other creatures like Werebear and Exalted Angel provide additional threats, while Survival of the Fittest helps tutor for key creatures. The deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and resource denial.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Gaea's Cradle and mana dorks like Birds of Paradise and Fyndhorn Elves, allowing for early plays of powerful creatures like Deranged Hermit and Masticore. It also aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Quirion Ranger and Mystic Snake, while also using Survival of the Fittest to tutor for key creatures. The deck is able to maintain board control with cards like Wall of Roots and Opposition, making it difficult for the opponent to establish a strong board presence.

The deck focuses on assembling a specific set of combo pieces to achieve a powerful and game-winning combination. It includes cards like Auramancer, Birds of Paradise, Ghitu Slinger, Mesmeric Fiend, Palinchron, and more to set up the combo. The goal is to use cards like Intuition, Cabal Therapy, and Duress to control the opponent's hand and disrupt their strategy while using cards like Survival of the Fittest to find the necessary combo pieces. The deck also includes mana-fixing lands to ensure smooth gameplay. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling the "Full English Breakfast" combo for a decisive victory.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive goblin creatures while using synergy between cards like Goblin Warchief and Goblin Ringleader to build a strong board presence and maintain card advantage. The main strategy is to play creatures early with cards like Goblin Lackey and Mogg Fanatic, and then use cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Siege-Gang Commander to deal direct damage and finish off the opponent. The deck also includes disruption elements like Wasteland and Rishadan Port to control the opponent's mana base.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's resources and hand with cards like Duress and Diabolic Edict, while also utilizing cards like Hypnotic Specter and Cursed Scroll to apply pressure and deal damage. The deck aims to control the game through discard spells, removal, and efficient threats like Skittering Skirge, backed up by utility lands like Mishra's Factory and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The overall strategy revolves around limiting the opponent's options and winning through consistent card advantage and board control.

The deck focuses on using the powerful Psychatog creature as a win condition by controlling the game through countering spells, card draw, and creature removal. It combines efficient counterspells and card draw with the ability to quickly grow Psychatog using the graveyard as a resource. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while slowly building up its own resources to overwhelm the opponent with a massive Psychatog attack.

The main concept of this deck revolves around using control elements such as counterspells, removal spells, and powerful enchantments like Standstill to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck focuses on controlling the board by leveraging card advantage and preventing the opponent from developing their own threats. By maintaining a strong defensive position and forcing the opponent to play on your terms, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent until it can secure a win condition, such as using Decree of Justice to create an army of tokens.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's movements and disrupt their strategy using counterspells, removal spells, and land destruction. It aims to maintain board control through efficient use of card advantage and tempo plays. The deck also includes land creatures to pressure the opponent while still being able to interact with spells. With a strong emphasis on control elements and resource management, the deck seeks to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through attrition.

The deck focuses on using cards like Attunement and Intuition to quickly dig through the deck and find Replenish, which allows the player to bring back powerful enchantments like Parallax Tide and Wave from the graveyard. Opalescence buffs these enchantments, turning them into creatures to attack opponents. Counterspells and removal like Swords to Plowshares help control the game until the combo can be assembled. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence and win the game through a devastating combo.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with fast and efficient creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, supplemented by burn spells like Incinerate and Lightning Bolt. The strategy is to aggressively attack the opponent's life total while using cards like Fireblast and Sulfuric Vortex to finish them off. The deck aims to maintain a steady stream of damage while also having the ability to deal direct damage to the opponent's creatures if needed. Overall, the deck is designed to be fast, aggressive, and relentless in its pursuit of victory.

The deck focuses on playing cheap, aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. It aims to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent by dealing damage consistently. The inclusion of powerful burn spells and cards like Grim Lavamancer and Sulfuric Vortex adds extra reach and inevitability to close out games. The deck is streamlined to prioritize maximum damage output and efficiency in order to win the game as quickly as possible.

This deck focuses on using cards like Meddling Mage to name important cards in the opponent's deck while getting Phyrexian Dreadnought onto the battlefield and stifling any potential responses. Counterspells and other control elements help protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to efficiently control the game and assemble its combo pieces to win quickly. Foil and Gush provide additional card advantage and flexibility, while cards like Opt and Portent help dig for key pieces. This deck requires precise timing and careful decision-making to effectively execute its game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play Phyrexian Dreadnought and prevent opponents from countering it by using Stifle. The deck includes various control and card draw cards to help find the necessary combo pieces. Powder Keg is included for additional disruption. By efficiently using countermagic and manipulation spells, this deck aims to assemble the Dreadnought combo and overwhelm opponents with a powerful creature. Additionally, Mishra's Factory is included as an alternate win condition.

The main concept of the deck is to use aggressive creatures like Terravore and Call of the Herd to pressure the opponent while disrupting their mana base with Armageddon and Wasteland. The deck also features cards like Swords to Plowshares and Vindicate to deal with opposing threats, with support from mana ramp like Mox Diamond and Birds of Paradise. The deck aims to quickly establish board control and tempo advantage by efficiently utilizing its resources and disrupting the opponent's game plan.
